entity_title: Foreigners working 6+ months must join BPJS Kesehatan
fact_text: Under Presidential Regulation (Perpres) 82/2018 on Health Insurance, a foreigner who works in Indonesia for at least 6 months is a Peserta (participant) in the national health insurance scheme and must pay BPJS Kesehatan contributions.
evidence_quote: Peserta adalah setiap orang, termasuk orang asing yang bekerja paling singkat 6 (enam) bulan di Indonesia, yang telah membayar Iuran Jaminan Kesehatan.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed only Indonesians pay into BPJS Kesehatan. Actually a foreigner working ≥6 months must enrol. Action: register with BPJS Kesehatan once the work stint passes 6 months.
